title: Settled Policy Registry
description: policy/settled.json — the versioned record of settled platform positions (D14). Skills, agent prompts, and gates cite entries by id instead of restating them. Changing a settled position means adding a superseding entry, never editing one in place.

supersedes.description: The prior position this entry replaces, quoted, when it supersedes an earlier settled stance.

consumers.description: Files, gates, and skills that cite this entry by id. Kept current so a policy change has a known blast radius.
